(1) the Coniagas volcanic rocks are the product of submarine explosive and (or) effusive eruptions, (2) the Coniagus volcanic rocks are hydroclastic, (3) the Coniaguas volcanic rocks are the result of explosive degasification of the magma, in conjunction with magma fragmentation due to interaction of magma– water, or nonexplosive degassing of magma, in conjunction to magma fragmentation due to the presence of gas bubbles in magma, and
